decisions.reason: It fits the firm's sensing-focused modular platform and has remained visible beyond launch, so prior development and public commitment make management more likely to continue unless weak demand becomes clearly persistent.

As a 3.0 generation replacement of an existing measurement module, it is embedded in the core product line, so dropping it would undermine an established platform investment and signal reversal of a deliberate upgrade path.

The CAN bus interface supports the firm's automation and embedded customers and broadens the platform's connectivity offering, so management is likely to retain it given its strategic fit and the absence of clear evidence of lasting failure.

The carbon dioxide sensor module matches the firm's modular sensing direction and was given its own product presentation, so sunk development effort and visible commitment make continued marketing more likely than withdrawal.
